title: Redistribution of cadmium in soil aggregates under continuous carbon and nitrogen inputs: insights from sequential extraction and modeling
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, 28,522-533
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00577A, Paper
Shixun Su, Weiqin Wu, Jiajiang Lin, Zuliang Chen
Continuous carbon (C) and nitrogen (N) inputs significantly affect cadmium (Cd) redistribution in soil aggregates, yet their impacts remain poorly understood.
